Changelog

demcrit 2.0.0

Corrections to Mana et al. (2026)

Two errors were found after publication of the article. Both were reported by @elliottower. None of the conclusions of the article change. See vignette("corrections") for every affected result.

  • MoCA-based algorithms now apply the global criterion MoCA < 27, as stated in Table 1 of the article. Published results used MoCA < 26 (#21). 12 of 68 algorithms (MoCA-based, IADL deficit by FAQ total score) gain 1 to 2 cases of probable PDD. Mean PDD rate changes from 6.21% to 6.34% (FAQ total algorithms: 9.10% to 9.37%); medians, ranges and all FAQ item 9 algorithms are unchanged.

  • concords is now computed on the 190 complete cases described in the article, consistent with rates. Published values used all cases available for each pair of algorithms, N = 190 to 202 (#20). Cohen’s kappa among FAQ total algorithms changes from 0.75 to 0.74, between algorithms differing only in IADL definition from 0.43 to 0.42; sMoCA sensitivity for Level II (FAQ total) classification changes from 0.95 to 1.00.

New data

  • rates_published and concords_published contain the values printed in the article (demcrit v1.2.0), kept for comparison.

Other

  • New vignette vignette("corrections").
  • The manuscript source (_manuscript/manuscript.qmd) now reads the current targets and renders the corrected author version of the article.
  • Package suggestions needed by the targets pipeline are listed in DESCRIPTION (#17).
